verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks as HTTP POST event messages pushed to an endpoint you define. The docs also cover HMAC signature verification, delivery-failure troubleshooting in the Customer Area, and specific event types such as account settings webhooks. A programmatic consumer can clearly subscribe and receive events. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of platform-specific (balance platform) webhook event types and the subscription/registration steps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook is a lightweight mechanism that allows an Adyen service to push event-driven messages using HTTP POST calls to an endpoint that you define.
By verifying this signature, you confirm that the webhook was sent by Adyen, and was not modified during transmission.
Use this guide to troubleshoot and resolve webhook delivery failures using the tools in your Customer Area.
an account settings webhook event is sent when: A merchant account or store is created, activated, deactivated, or closed.
